    • agregarAlSimulador

      public void agregarAlSimulador()
      This method adds selected cyclists from the selection panel to the simulator panel. It checks if the number of selected cyclists exceeds the limit of 6, in which case it displays an error message and exits the method. Then, it iterates over the rows of the table in the selection panel, and for each selected cyclist, it updates the corresponding labels in the simulator panels for different terrains (llano, montaña, plano, semillano) with the cyclist's ID.

    • ActualizarEscuadra

      public void ActualizarEscuadra()
      Updates the information of the selected team. Retrieves the country flag and name entered by the user from the view. Sets the country and name of the team in a new EscuadraDTO object. Note: The actual update operation on the database is commented out.

    • crearUsuario

      public int crearUsuario()
      Creates a new user based on the information provided in the registration panel. Retrieves the user's personal details such as ID, gender, email, and password. Validates the email address format. Validates the uniqueness of the user ID. Determines the type of user (Director, Cyclist, Masseur, or Administrative) based on radio button selection. Creates a new instance of the corresponding UserDTO subclass. Attempts to create the user in the database via the UserDAO. Returns an integer indicating the success or failure of the user creation process: 1 - User created successfully. 0 - An error occurred during user creation (e.g., invalid input, duplicate user ID).

    • mostrarTipoCiclista

      public void mostrarTipoCiclista()
      Displays the details of the logged-in cyclist based on their type. Checks the type of the logged-in user using instanceof operator and calls the respective method to display their details. If the logged-in user is of type CiclistaDTO, it calls the mostrarCiclista() method. If the logged-in user is of type ClasicoManoDTO, it calls the mostrarCiclistaClasicoMano() method. If the logged-in user is of type ContraRelojDTO, it calls the mostrarCiclistaContraReloj() method. If the logged-in user is of type EmbaladorDTO, it calls the mostrarCiclistaEmbalador() method. If the logged-in user is of type EscaladorDTO, it calls the mostrarCiclistaEscalador() method. If the logged-in user is of type GregarioDTO, it calls the mostrarCiclistaGregario() method. If the logged-in user is of type RodadorDTO, it calls the mostrarCiclistaRodador() method.

    • tipoCiclistaMostrar

      public void tipoCiclistaMostrar()
      Updates the display based on the type of cyclist selected. Checks the selected radio button in the panel and shows relevant fields accordingly. If the "Clasico Mano" radio button is selected, it displays fields related to classic races won. If the "Contrarreloj" radio button is selected, it displays fields related to time trial cycling. If the "Embalador" radio button is selected, it displays fields related to sprinting ability. If the "Escalador" radio button is selected, it displays fields related to climbing ability. If the "Gregario" radio button is selected, it displays fields related to supporting roles in a cycling team. If the "Rodador" radio button is selected, it displays fields related to endurance cycling. If the "Vacio" (Empty) radio button is selected, it clears the panel. Repaints the panel to ensure changes are visible.

    • login

      public void login()
      Validates the user's credentials and updates the user interface accordingly. If the credentials are correct, it displays the main options panel and sets the user label. If the credentials are incorrect, it shows an error message and resets the login interface.

    • eliminarUsuarioMasajista

      public void eliminarUsuarioMasajista()
      Deletes a masajista (masseur) user from the system based on the entered user ID. Retrieves the user ID from the corresponding text field in the user interface. Searches for the position of the user in the user data access object (DAO) based on the ID. If the user is found, deletes the user from the DAO and displays a success message. If the user is not found, displays a message indicating that the user was not found.

If the user is not found, displays a message indicating that the user was not found.

    • llenarUsuarioACiclista

    • actualizarCiclista

      public void actualizarCiclista()
      Updates the information of the logged-in user if they are a cyclist. Retrieves the identifier, accumulated time, physique, pedaling cadence, years of experience, and name entered in the "Actualizar Ciclista" panel from the user interface. If the logged-in user is a cyclist: - Sets the retrieved data to the corresponding fields of the logged-in cyclist DTO. - Calls the update method of the user DAO to persist the changes. If the logged-in user is not a cyclist: - Creates a new cyclist DTO object and sets the retrieved data along with the general user information. - Calls the update method of the user DAO with the index of the logged-in user and the new cyclist DTO to update the user information.

    • actualizarTipoCiclista

      public void actualizarTipoCiclista()
      Updates the type of cyclist based on the selection made in the "Actualizar Ciclista" panel. If the "Clasico de Mano" option is selected: - Calls the method to update Clasico de Mano cyclist. If the "Contrarreloj" option is selected: - Calls the method to update Contrarreloj cyclist. If the "Embalador" option is selected: - Calls the method to update Embalador cyclist. If the "Escalador" option is selected: - Calls the method to update Escalador cyclist. If the "Gregario" option is selected: - Calls the method to update Gregario cyclist. If the "Rodador" option is selected: - Calls the method to update Rodador cyclist. If no specific type is selected: - Calls the generic update method.

    • crearUsuarioADirector

      public void crearUsuarioADirector()
      Creates a new DirectorDeportivoDTO object based on the information provided in the user interface and adds it to the data access object. This method retrieves the nationality and full name from the corresponding text fields in the user interface. It creates a new instance of DirectorDeportivoDTO and sets its common attributes (cedula, genero, correoElectronico, id, contrasenia) using the attributes of the currently logged-in user obtained from the mf.getUsuarioLoginDTO() method. Then, it sets the nationality and full name of the new DirectorDeportivoDTO object. Finally, it adds the new DirectorDeportivoDTO object to the user data access object.

    • crearUsuarioACiclistaClasicoMano

      public void crearUsuarioACiclistaClasicoMano()
      Creates a new ClasicoManoDTO object based on the information provided in the user interface and adds it to the data access object. If the logged-in user is a DirectorDeportivo, it checks if the user with the provided ID already exists. If not, it creates a new user with the provided information. If the logged-in user is not a DirectorDeportivo, it updates the information of the existing user with the provided information. This method retrieves the user's personal information such as ID, email, password, and gender from the corresponding text fields and combo boxes in the user interface. It also retrieves cycling-related information such as accumulated time, cyclist ID, body build, pedaling cadence, years of experience, and number of classic wins. Then, it creates a new instance of ClasicoManoDTO and sets its attributes using the retrieved information. If the logged-in user is a DirectorDeportivo, it checks if the user with the provided ID already exists. If not, it sets the common attributes (cedula, genero, correoElectronico, id, contrasenia) and adds the new ClasicoManoDTO object to the user data access object. If the user already exists, it displays an error message. If the logged-in user is not a DirectorDeportivo, it sets the common attributes (cedula, genero, correoElectronico, id, contrasenia) of the logged-in user and updates the existing user information with the new ClasicoManoDTO object.

    • TipoUsuariologin

      public String TipoUsuariologin()
      Retrieves the type of the logged-in user. This method checks the type of the logged-in user based on the instance of the UsuarioDTO. It returns a string representing the type of user.
      Returns:
      A string representing the type of the logged-in user: - "DirectorDeportivo" for DirectorDeportivoDTO instances. - "Ciclista" for CiclistaDTO instances. - "Masajista" for MasajistaDTO instances. - "Administrativo" for other types of UsuarioDTO instances.

    • irSimulacion

      public void irSimulacion()
      Switches the visibility of simulation panels based on the selected map type.

      This method hides the panel for choosing the map and shows the simulation panel corresponding to the selected map type from the drop-down list. The possible map types are "semillano", "montaña", "plano", and "llano". Depending on the selected map type, the corresponding simulation panel is made visible.

      If the selected map type does not match any of the predefined types, no action is taken.
